accounts.notes: 70% of total portfolio. Two bank-managed portfolios (one risky, one conservative). WRAPPER UNKNOWN. If fondkonto/depa: taxable at 30% on gains AND likely 1.2-1.6% fund fees = the largest structural inefficiency in the portfolio. Test: has any sale here ever generated capital gains tax in deklaration? Ask Handelsbanken directly. No agent output about this account is trustworthy until wrapper is confirmed.

Confirmed ISK. Tax-free allowance headroom = allowance threshold minus ALL ISK/KF savings capital across institutions. With only this ISK, ~264k SEK headroom remains (verify current threshold with Skatteverket).

Confirmed taxable - user paid capital gains tax on a prior sale. Childhood fund, likely low cost basis = high gain percentage but small absolute tax on full disposal. Prime candidate for move-to-ISK math: one-time tax hit vs permanent tax-free compounding.

Direct ETH, no wrapper possible. Swedish tax: 30% on gains via K4, and EVERY disposal is a taxable event - including token swaps, not just SEK sales. Alternative for crypto exposure: certificate inside ISK (no per-trade tax, but ~2%/yr fee + issuer counterparty risk). Agents must never treat a wallet swap as tax-neutral.
